text: Gardening, a pastime enjoyed by many, provides a multitude of benefits, including improved soil health, enhanced aesthetic appeal, and a positive effect on mental wellbeing. A crucial component of a flourishing garden is mulch, which retains moisture, prevents weeds, and adds nutrients to the soil. Conversely, compost plays an equally vital role, reducing soil erosion, deterring pests and diseases, and enriching the soil with organic material, thereby fostering a bountiful harvest. In contrast to mulch, compost significantly enhances the soil's health, rendering it more fertile and resilient, thus benefiting not only plants but also beneficial insects and microorganisms. By integrating both mulch and compost into their gardening routine, individuals can cultivate a thriving, sustainable, and environmentally conscious garden.
